headline: Jefferies Upgrades Orion Rating Following Nubeqa Patent Outlook
summary: Jefferies upgraded its rating on Finnish pharmaceutical firm Orion, citing an improved patent outlook for its prostate cancer drug Nubeqa.
why: Orion Corporation is a global pharmaceutical manufacturer whose earnings are heavily influenced by patent protection and royalties from key commercial drugs.
why_moved: Positive patent projections reduce key drug revenue risks, leading analysts to upgrade price targets and boosting buying interest.
